set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically.

Problem
A label drawn over an image usually needs a background plate. Today the host has to guess the plate width, because it cannot measure text through the scene API.

Scope
An optional background plate on text grobs (fill, padding, corner radius), sized from the backend's own text metrics.

Acceptance criteria
1. On every backend, the plate tightly bounds the rendered text within the padding, including when a fallback font is used.
2. Plates are excluded from picking unless requested.
3. The gallery includes an example.
set.title: [Intaglio] Text background plate sized from measured text
